description.value: Cit-E Cycles is an e-bike specialty retailer claiming Canada's largest selection, with six BC locations including this Lower Lonsdale shop steps from the Spirit Trail waterfront path and the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal. Staff have first-hand knowledge of demanding North Shore terrain — steep climbs to Upper Lonsdale, Capilano, and Lynn Valley — and are equipped to match riders to appropriate motor and battery capacity. The shop runs a full-service repair department covering all e-bike brands, handled by certified technicians.
